rationale: The elaborated proposition is a faithful formal packaging of Lemma 3.3. It uses real matrices of the correct dimensions, constructs Atilde=XA YA^T and Btilde=YB XB^T, requires orthonormality only of XA and XB, retains both approximation bounds, and represents exactly the two direct multiplication orders through three normwise rounded-product stages. Its Frobenius norm, gamma function, cost c=b+2r^(3/2), exact-versus-computed distinctions, and both complete forward-error conclusions agree with the PDF. The stage-level error relation is the explicit equation (2.7) abstraction used by the paper's proof, and the execution hypotheses are satisfiable in nondegenerate cases.
